mostWorthwhile.text: Adding oxygen to the red cells was most worthwhile: the attachment and release arrows explained how they can carry oxygen from the lungs to tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the red cells and then the remaining components was clear but a little predictable because the outlines showed exactly what was missing.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the mature red cells had no nuclei, even though the developing cells started with them.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the pictures and goals made the pairings clear. The chapter did not explain in detail how developing red cells lose their nuclei.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how blood reaches tissues, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than filling the remaining outlines.
